resources.string: A small, disappointed goblin. Tap for offline sarcasm.

General Response Unit for Media Pessimism

v0.2.0 · Offline and unimpressed

1. Return to your home screen.
2. Long-press an empty area and choose Widgets.
3. Find GRUMP and drag him home.
4. Tap him. Regret interrupting him.

Resize by long-pressing the widget and dragging its handles. If you use large text, give him extra room.

100 comments. No account. No internet. No background polling. Each GRUMP has his own mood.

His bubble stays until you poke him again. He has nowhere else to be.
